leads.claim: The document includes a standard operating procedure instruction to secure signed statements and obtain fragments or physical evidence from UAP incidents.
leads.why: This is an administrative instruction confirming that the government had a formal policy to attempt the recovery of physical material from UAP events.
leads.quote: Obtain fragments or physical evidence where possible.

doc_verdict: The document contains no evidence that the government successfully obtained or held UAP material, only a procedural instruction to attempt such recovery if possible.
